magenta.why: named for the Battle of Magenta (1859), the year the dye was named

navy.why: the dark blue of the Royal Navy's officers' uniforms from 1748

tiffany-blue.why: Tiffany and Co. brand color (a trademark; hex is approximate)

falu-red.why: named for the Falun copper mine in Sweden, source of the pigment

denim.why: named for the twilled cotton cloth (serge de Nimes)

petrol.why: named for the fuel's iridescent blue-green sheen

cosmic-latte.why: named in 2002 by Johns Hopkins astronomers for the average color of the universe's light

pomp-and-power.why: a Wikipedia-listed name; origin not documented in our data
